about: Waymark's routine contract and catalog of testigos (docs/adr/0006, 0012): the single source of what each task must do. A testigo answers its `claim` by executing (tool calls, git, a re-run), never by reading the agent's prose, and returns ✔ / ✘ / not applicable with its evidence; `enforce: block` stops the turn once when it fails, `record` only scores it. stop-hook.mjs judges them (the ones that need a process or git live in scripts/testigos.mjs, which also re-runs them by hand); the instructions block quotes every block claim; tests/hooks.test.mjs fails if they drift. Change a testigo here, nowhere else. Decision = the user's answer in the choice window, recorded as is; a question after the first change is recorded with its position and does not count against it (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2q). Gate = the exit of the agent's last gate after its last code change, else the repo typecheck re-run by the hook (40 s; never the full build); a failing gate blocks once (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2q). The memory line is written by the end-of-turn hook from the Cierre's Aprendido and the one index is the git notes (docs/adr/0012, 3e-2): neither is a testigo. Every testigo that applies blocks once, except the commit trailer (fixing it rewrites a commit, 2026-10-03 · T2j) and the chain (Waymark's own file). The pre-tool hook stops a commit without the trailer once, before it runs (tool-hook.mjs). An exception line written after a block (no comprobado, Tests: no, Build: no, Secretos: no) passes its testigo as ⚠ (exception), never as ✔; a skip quoted as the user's needs 3 of their words (user's choice, 2026-10-12 · T8). No browser testigo: browser verification runs only when the user asks (2026-10-03 · T2l). The notes testigo is judged after the record (the hook pushes the notes once the record is their note): a push the hook's process cannot make blocks once with `W notes push` per repo, and the next stop checks the tracking refs; it is not in that record's score (user's choice, 2026-10-15 · T3); it applies only to a project the user said yes for (`Notes push:`), with no yes the notes stay local (user's choice, 2026-10-19 · T5, docs/adr/0042).

testigos.label: Decision
testigos.claim: the choice window answered before the first change

testigos.label: Verificar
testigos.claim: a gate passing after the last code change

testigos.label: Evidencia
testigos.claim: an Evidencia "observada" checked after the last change

testigos.label: Secretos
testigos.claim: no secret in the memory or the task's diff and commits

testigos.label: Recordar
testigos.claim: each file's memory pack, handed by the hook at its first edit (never run pack)

testigos.label: Review
testigos.claim: L2+ with risky code: code-review (or W review <files>) once at the task's end

testigos.label: Build
testigos.claim: L2+ with code: the build once at the end

testigos.label: Ojos
testigos.claim: a seen change measured or clicked in a browser after the last change

testigos.label: Docs
testigos.claim: a command that failed twice runs again only after consulting the docs

testigos.label: Enrutar
testigos.claim: the owner's procedures.md section read before the first change

testigos.label: Tests
testigos.claim: a spec next to the changed code added or changed

testigos.label: Tests
testigos.claim: L2+ with a spec and code changed: the spec ran before the code it tests, or in a clean worktree

testigos.label: Previos
testigos.claim: a failing gate that is not this task's shown failing in a clean copy

testigos.label: Notas
testigos.claim: after a push, opted-in notes on the remote (else `W notes push`)

testigos.label: Commit
testigos.claim: the task's commits carry Waymark-Task: <task ID>

testigos.label: Cadena
testigos.claim: the provenance chain intact before this record
